import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Clean up 'Sleep Disorder' column for clarity in plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True)
df['Systolic'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Systolic'])
df['Diastolic'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Diastolic'])

# Set a logical order for BMI Category for better visualization
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)


# --- Visualization ---
# Set theme and create a figure with a 2x3 grid of subplots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(22, 14), constrained_layout=True)
fig.suptitle('Health & Lifestyle Factors by Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=28, weight='bold', y=1.05)

# Define a clear color palette for the groups
palette = {"No Disorder": "#3498db", "Sleep Apnea": "#e74c3c"}

# Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Duration
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    palette=palette,
    s=200,
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='k'
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration', fontsize=18)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Disorder Status')

# Plot 2: Stress Level Distribution
sns.boxplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Stress Level',
    palette=palette,
    width=0.5
)
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Stress Level',
    color='0.2',
    jitter=0.1,
    size=8
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Stress Level Comparison', fontsize=18)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)')

# Plot 3: BMI Category Distribution
sns.countplot(
    ax=axes[0, 2],
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    palette=palette,
    order=bmi_order
)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Distribution of BMI Categories', fontsize=18)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 2].get_legend().remove()

# Plot 4: Heart Rate Distribution
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Heart Rate',
    palette=palette,
    inner='quartile',
    cut=0
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution', fontsize=18)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')

# Plot 5: Systolic Blood Pressure
sns.boxplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Systolic',
    palette=palette,
    width=0.5
)
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Systolic',
    color='0.2',
    jitter=0.1,
    size=8
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Systolic Blood Pressure', fontsize=18)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)')

# Plot 6: Physical Activity Level
sns.kdeplot(
    ax=axes[1, 2],
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    palette=palette,
    fill=True,
    alpha=0.5,
    linewidth=2,
    clip=(0, None)
)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Physical Activity Density', fontsize=18)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Physical Activity (minutes/day)')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Density')
axes[1, 2].get_legend().remove()

# Save the final visualization
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
